name: Shoot Zombies For Brainrots!
desc:
🧟 Welcome to Shoot Zombies For Brainrots!

🔫 Shoot down waves of zombies and collect Brainrots!
🧟 Don't let the zombie horde overrun you!
💸 Upgrade your Brainrots and earn more money!
🔫 Upgrade your arsenal to unlock more firepower!
🏗️ Upgrade your base to unlock more slots!

👍 Like the game and join the group!
